impact: Renderer subscribes to cove/engine/ready after main has already replayed lastReadyPayload, leaving v2State stuck in BOOTING until an explicit engine.restart() forces a new ready event. Evidence path: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-22-t-010c-slice-3-m1-smoke-completion-retry-2/blocker-initial-ready-race/
resolution: Renderer now reconciles current engine readiness after registering subscriptions via existing engine.version IPC and routes both live onReady and reconcile through the same readiness handler. Manual validation confirmed first launch exits BOOTING without engine.restart() and RecoveryBanner/IDLE UI becomes reachable. Fix commit: 0c38503. Evidence: .story/handovers/evidence/2026-05-23-iss-013-engine-ready-race-resolved/
title: Renderer can miss initial engine.ready and remain in BOOTING
